{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMiPDwgNK4sQdz8VCibp","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TypeInference.md ===\n# FEATURE: Type Inference\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Infer each column's type among integer, number, boolean, text, and empty from its non-null values. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-NullTrim.md, ARCHITECTURE.md |\n| Provides    | typing.Infer |\n| Consumes    | reader.IsNull, reader.Trim |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nGive every column a type so later stories choose the right min, max, and numeric statistics.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Inference runs over the trimmed, non-null values of one column. Null values never influence the type.\n- A column takes the first of `integer`, `number`, `date`, `boolean`, `text` that every non-null value satisfies. A column with no non-null value is `empty`.\n- `integer`: every value matches `-?[0-9]+`.\n- `number`: every value matches `-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?`. A column mixing integer and decimal values is `number`.\n- `boolean`: every value equals `true` or `false`, ignoring case.\n- `text`: anything else.\n- `date` is recognized by `typing.IsDate`, supplied by the date-type story. In this story the date check is a hook, `func(string) bool`, that defaults to returning false, so a column of dates is `text` until that story installs the real check. The hook sits between `number` and `boolean` in the order.\n- `typing.Infer(values []string) string` takes already-trimmed values, skips nulls via `reader.IsNull`, and returns the type token.\n- The profile output writes the token in the `type` column.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC type-integer-and-number ===\nIntent: Integer, mixed integer-and-decimal, and negative columns are typed integer and number as the contract states.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ncols = {\n    \"ints\": [\"1\", \"-20\", \"300\", \"0\"],\n    \"mixed\": [\"1\", \"2.5\", \"-3\", \"4.25\"],\n    \"decs\": [\"0.5\", \"-1.75\", \"10.0\", \"3.14\"],\n}\nnames = list(cols)\nnrows = len(cols[names[0]])\nlines = [\",\".join(names)]\nfor i in range(nrows):\n    lines.append(\",\".join(cols[n][i] for n in names))\ntext = \"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\nassert rows[\"ints\"][\"type\"] == \"integer\"\nassert rows[\"mixed\"][\"type\"] == \"number\"\nassert rows[\"decs\"][\"type\"] == \"number\"\n=== END AC type-integer-and-number ===\n\n=== AC type-boolean-case-insensitive ===\nIntent: A column of true and false in any letter case is boolean, while a column mixing a boolean with other text is text.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ncols = {\n    \"flag\": [\"true\", \"FALSE\", \"True\", \"false\"],\n    \"maybe\": [\"true\", \"false\", \"yes\", \"true\"],\n}\nnames = list(cols)\nnrows = len(cols[names[0]])\nlines = [\",\".join(names)]\nfor i in range(nrows):\n    lines.append(\",\".join(cols[n][i] for n in names))\ntext = \"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\nassert rows[\"flag\"][\"type\"] == \"boolean\"\nassert rows[\"maybe\"][\"type\"] == \"text\"\n=== END AC type-boolean-case-insensitive ===\n\n=== AC type-text-fallback ===\nIntent: A column with one non-numeric value among integers falls back to text.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom drydb_placeholder import nothing  # noqa: F401\n=== END AC type-text-fallback ===\n\n=== AC type-nulls-ignored ===\nIntent: Null spellings (empty, NA, N/A, NULL in any case) do not change the inferred type, and an all-null column is empty.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ncols = {\n    \"n\": [\"5\", \"\", \"NA\", \"n/a\", \"Null\", \"7\"],\n    \"allnull\": [\"\", \"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\", \"null\", \" \"],\n    \"word\": [\"red\", \"\", \"blue\", \"NA\", \"green\", \"NULL\"],\n}\nnames = list(cols)\nnrows = len(cols[names[0]])\nlines = [\",\".join(names)]\nfor i in range(nrows):\n    lines.append(\",\".join(cols[n][i] for n in names))\ntext = \"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\nassert rows[\"n\"][\"type\"] == \"integer\"\nassert rows[\"allnull\"][\"type\"] == \"empty\"\nassert rows[\"word\"][\"type\"] == \"text\"\n=== END AC type-nulls-ignored ===\n\n=== AC type-header-only-empty ===\nIntent: A file with a header and no data records types every column as empty.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\nnames = [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"]\ntext = \",\".join(names) + \"\\n\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert [r[\"column\"] for r in rows] == names\nassert date. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-TypeInference.md, ARCHITECTURE.md |\n| Provides    | typing.IsDate |\n| Consumes    | typing.Infer |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLet a column of calendar dates be typed `date`, while near-misses such as `2025-02-30` leave the column as `text`.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- `typing.IsDate(s string) bool` is true only when `s` matches `YYYY-MM-DD` (four, two, two digits, hyphen-separated) and names a real calendar date, leap years included.\n- Validation uses `time.Parse` with layout `2006-01-02` plus a check that the formatted result equals the input, or an equivalent exact check, so no value is normalized into validity.\n- The date hook in `typing.Infer` is bound to `typing.IsDate`. A column is `date` only when every non-null value satisfies it and not every value is an integer or number.\n- One non-date value makes the column fall to the next matching type (`boolean` or \"\\n\".join(values) + \"\\n\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TypeInference.md ===\n# FEATURE: Type Inference\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Infer each column's type among integer, number, boolean, text, and empty from its non-null values. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-NullTrim.md, ARCHITECTURE.md |\n| Provides    | typing.Infer |\n| Consumes    | reader.IsNull, reader.Trim |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nGive every column a type so later stories choose the right min, max, and numeric statistics.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Inference runs over the trimmed, non-null values of one column. Null values never influence the type.\n- A column takes the first of `integer`, `number`, `date`, `boolean`, `text` that every non-null value satisfies. A column with no non-null value is `empty`.\n- `integer`: every value matches `-?[0-9]+`.\n- `number`: every value matches `-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?`. A column mixing integer and decimal values is `number`.\n- `boolean`: every value equals `true` or `false`, ignoring case.\n- `text`: anything else.\n- `date` is recognized by `typing.IsDate`, supplied by the date-type story. In this story the date check is a hook, `func(string) bool`, that defaults to returning false, so a column of dates is `text` until that story installs the real check. The hook sits between `number` and `boolean` in the order.\n- `typing.Infer(values []string) string` takes already-trimmed values, skips nulls via `reader.IsNull`, and returns the type token.\n- The profile output writes the token in the `type` column.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC type-integer-and-number ===\nIntent: Integer, mixed integer-and-decimal, and negative columns are typed integer and number as the contract states.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ncols = {\n    \"ints\": [\"1\", \"-20\", \"300\", \"0\"],\n    \"mixed\": [\"1\", \"2.5\", \"-3\", \"4.25\"],\n    \"decs\": [\"0.5\", \"-1.75\", \"10.0\", \"3.14\"],\n}\nnames = list(cols)\nnrows = len(cols[names[0]])\nlines = [\",\".join(names)]\nfor i in range(nrows):\n    lines.append(\",\".join(cols[n][i] for n in names))\ntext = \"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\nassert rows[\"ints\"][\"type\"] == \"integer\"\nassert rows[\"mixed\"][\"type\"] == \"number\"\nassert rows[\"decs\"][\"type\"] == \"number\"\n=== END AC type-integer-and-number ===\n\n=== AC type-boolean-case-insensitive ===\nIntent: A column of true and false in any letter case is boolean, while a column mixing a boolean with other text is text.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ncols = {\n    \"flag\": [\"true\", \"FALSE\", \"True\", \"false\"],\n    \"maybe\": [\"true\", \"false\", \"yes\", \"true\"],\n}\nnames = list(cols)\nnrows = len(cols[names[0]])\nlines = [\",\".join(names)]\nfor i in range(nrows):\n    lines.append(\",\".join(cols[n][i] for n in names))\ntext = \"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\nassert rows[\"flag\"][\"type\"] ==   code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert [r[\"column\"] for r in rows] == names\nassert FEATURE: Date Type\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Recognize date columns whose every non-null value is a real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-TypeInference.md, ARCHITECTURE.md |\n| Provides    | typing.IsDate |\n| Consumes    | typing.Infer |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLet a column of calendar dates be typed `date`, while near-misses such as `2025-02-30` leave the column as `text`.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- `typing.IsDate(s string) bool` is true only when `s` matches `YYYY-MM-DD` (four, two, two digits, hyphen-separated) and names a real calendar date, leap years included.\n- Validation uses `time.Parse` with layout `2006-01-02` plus a check that the formatted result equals the input, or an equivalent exact check, so no value is normalized into validity.\n- The date hook in `typing.Infer` is bound to `typing.IsDate`. A column is `date` only when every non-null value satisfies it and not every value is an integer or number.\n- One non-date value makes the column fall to the next matching type (`boolean` or \"\\n\".join(values) + \"\\n\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert len(rows) == 1\nassert rows[0][\"type\"] == \"date\"\n=== tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        fh.write(text)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, (code, out, err)\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows[0][\"type\"] == \"text\"\n=== END AC date-invalid-calendar-day None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nSupply the `rows`, `nulls`, and `distinct` fields of each profile row.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- `rows` is the number of data records (the header is not counted). Comparison is case-sensitive, so `Acme` and `acme` are two values; `  Globex  ` and `Globex` are one.\n- An all-null or zero-row column has `distinct` 0.\n- `profile.Counts(values []string) (rows, nulls, distinct int)` takes trimmed values.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC counts-rows-nulls-distinct ===\nIntent: rows, nulls, and distinct match the counts derived from the supplied column values.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\nNULLS = {\"\", \"na\", \"n/a\", \"null\"}\nvalues = [\"apple\", \"pear\", \"apple\", \"\", \"NA\",
